verdict.rationale: Google Workspace exposes documented public REST APIs (Admin SDK Directory API, Reports API, Cloud Identity API) with reference docs, enabling programmatic/agentic control of many admin tasks. missing for 10: no discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI/llms.txt spec (probes returned 404s), and evidence doesn't show core productivity APIs (Docs/Sheets/Gmail) being documented in this pack, only admin-console functions.
